post.text:
First Look at Gaten Matarazzo as Smoke Jr. and Stack Jr. in 'SINNERS: LEGACY'

Ryan Coogler will not return. Louis Leterrier ('FAST X', 'GRIMSBY') is set to direct.

(Source: https://t.co/TYzmsLw16I) https://t.co/u03T3IPqf0

description.description: A group of four young adults looking forward with various expressions of concern and surprise in an indoor setting. In the foreground, a man with curly hair and glasses looks downward-left. Behind him, another man with curly hair and glasses, a man in a tan jacket and tie, and a woman with her hair in a ponytail are visible. A light-colored flag with red stars is partially visible in the background.
